concerns.text: The plan states a performance goal of end‑to‑end wall‑clock ≤ 45 min on the GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM). Given the required baseline computation (≥5 noise‑free trajectories of ≥50 000 steps per dimension) plus the full noisy‑trajectory grid (e.g., N = 3,5; 6 noise levels; 30 trials each → 360 noisy runs of 10 000 steps), the total integration workload is likely to exceed the 45‑minute limit on the free CPU runner. This makes the current compute feasibility claim unrealistic and could cause CI timeouts. Adjust the experimental design (e.g., reduce trial count, shorten baseline length, or add a multi‑core parallelisation strategy) to ensure the pipeline can complete within the free‑tier constraints.
